subject_notes: Commercial EO satellites; Planet Labs Federal, Inc. for NRO/NGA/DoD. BlackSky-adjacent positioning. FY22 10-K is the first as a public company (post-SPAC dMY IV merger Dec 2021).
extraction_summary: FY22 10-K is narratively LIGHT on specific Pentagon Program Elements (PE numbers) or named DoD programs (e.g., no Project Maven / SDA Tracking Layer / SBIR programs called out). Defense & Intelligence is framed as a future market opportunity through 'sharable, unclassified subscription products'. Federal exposure is structural (Planet Federal, Inc. exists as a Washington DC sub) but the 10-K does not quantify a single Pentagon-program-revenue concentration nor name a single PE. This itself is a finding: the J-Book divergence pattern needs SPECIFIC program-revenue claims to trigger, and PL does not provide them in this filing.

claims.claim_text: Planet operates Planet Labs Federal, Inc., a subsidiary headquartered in a 3,000 sq ft Washington, D.C. office, serving as the corporate headquarters for U.S. federal/defense engagement (implicit federal channel claim).
claims.subject: Planet Labs Federal, Inc.
claims.source_quote: We also have an approximately 3,000 square foot Washington, D.C. office that serves as the corporate headquarters for Planet Federal.

claims.claim_text: Planet expects 'Defense & Intelligence' to be a significant market driver via sharable, unclassified subscription products complementing traditional defense/security industrial solutions — forward narrative without naming a specific Pentagon program.
claims.subject: Planet Labs PBC
claims.object_value: Defense & Intelligence vertical — unclassified subscription products
claims.source_quote: Defense & Intelligence: Governments are strategically engaging with commercial space and remote sensing companies to leverage sharable, unclassified subscription products to complement more traditional defense and security industrial solutions.

claims.claim_text: Planet operates a fleet of ~200 satellites including 21 SkySat high-resolution agile-tasking satellites, providing the backbone for tasking-based revenue (including federal tasking).
claims.subject: Planet Labs PBC
claims.object_value: 21 SkySats + ~180 Doves/SuperDoves; up to 10 revisits/day at 50cm
claims.source_quote: Planet Tasking: With 21 SkySat satellites in orbit, our high-resolution rapid revisit capability can capture a specified location up to ten times per day at a resolution of up to 50 cm.

claims.claim_text: Planet's strategy depends on continuing to capture 'certain high-value government procurement contracts' as a forward driver of growth (named as a forward risk factor in cautionary language).
claims.subject: Planet Labs PBC
claims.source_quote: the competitiveness of Planet's geospatial data set and analytic capabilities relative to other commercial entities and governments, including Planet's ability to continue to capture certain high-value government procurement contracts

claims.claim_text: Planet partnered with Carbon Mapper (non-profit) and NASA JPL to build two hyperspectral satellites for emissions tracking — forward technology pipeline, NASA-funded (not DoD).
claims.subject: Planet Labs PBC
claims.object_value: Carbon Mapper + NASA JPL hyperspectral mission
claims.source_quote: Carbon Mapper: We have partnered with a new non-profit launched in April 2021 called Carbon Mapper... together with NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, we will build and launch two satellites as an initial proof of concept.

claims.claim_text: Planet serves over 700 customers across commercial and government verticals, with over 90% signing annual or multi-year contracts (avg ~2 years).
claims.subject: Planet Labs PBC
claims.object_value: 770 EoP customers (25% YoY growth); >90% annual/multi-year; ~2-year avg
claims.source_quote: As of January 31, 2022, our EoP Customer Count was 770 customers... Over 90% of our customers sign annual or multiyear contracts, with an average contract length of approximately 2 years.

claims.claim_text: Planet positions itself as differentiated from legacy EO providers who 'prioritized serving national defense and intelligence customers before attempting to sell excess capacity to the commercial market' — narrative-level claim of broad addressable defense/intel market.
claims.subject: Planet Labs PBC
claims.object_value: displace legacy defense-prioritized EO providers (Maxar, BlackSky implied)
claims.source_quote: Earth Observation providers prioritized serving national defense and intelligence customers before attempting to sell excess capacity to the commercial market.

claims.claim_text: Planet operates from facilities in San Francisco, Washington DC (Planet Federal), and has wholly-owned foreign subsidiaries in Canada, Germany, Luxembourg, Singapore, and the Netherlands.
claims.subject: Planet Labs PBC
claims.object_value: SF HQ + DC Planet Federal sub + 5 foreign subs
claims.source_quote: The Company is headquartered in San Francisco, California... has wholly-owned foreign subsidiaries in Canada, Germany, Luxembourg, Singapore and the Netherlands.
